 1 | Blur | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | U
 2 | Shield | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | U
 3 | Airwall | 10’x10’x3’ | 1 min/lvl | 50’ | E
 4 | Prayer I | 1 target | varies | 100’ | U
 5 | Deflections I | 1 missile | - | 10’ | U
 6 | Self Cloaking | caster | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | self | U
 7 | Earthwall | 10’x10’x3’ | 1 min/lvl | 50’ | E
 8 | Prayer II | 1 target | varies | 100’ | U
 9 | Bladeturn I | 1 attack | - | 10’ | U

12 | Prayer III | 1 target | varies | 100’ | U
13 | Stonewall | 10’x10’x1’ | 1 min/lvl | 50’ | E
14 | Spell Shield I | caster | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | self | U
15 | Bladeturn II | 2 attacks | - | 10’ | U
16 | Aura True | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | U
17 | Prayer IV | 1 target | varies | 100’ | U
18 | Deflections III | 3 missiles | - | 10’ | U
19 | Bladeturn III | 3 attacks | - | 10’ | U
20 | Spell Shield II | caster | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | self | U
25 | Curved Wall | varies | 1 min/lvl | 50’ | E
30 | Mass Deflections | 1 missile/lvl | - | 10’ | U
50 | Defense Mastery | caster | varies | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all
attacks.
@@ 2
Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a
normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does
not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.
@@ 3
Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10’x10’x3’. This wall reduces all
movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a
-50 penalty.
@@ 4
Target gets a +5 bonus to his RRs and maneuver rolls. The duration of this
spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a
mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast
on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If caster is the
target, the duration is 1 minute per level.
@@ 5
Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10 feet of him (caster
must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the
missile’s attack.
@@ 6
Caster blends into surrounding terrain. This results in a +75 bonus to Hiding
attempts. Caster may not move (appreciably) without loosing this bonus.
@@ 7
Creates a wall of packed earth up to 10’x10’x3’. This wall can be chopped
through or toppled (if not propped up somehow).
@@ 8
As Prayer I, except the total the bonus is 10 and may be spread over 1-2
targets. One target would get +10 and two would get +5 each.
@@ 9
Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range).
This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.
@@ 10
Creates a bright aura around the caster, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 15 from all attacks against him.
@@ 11
As Deflections I, except it will deflect up to two missiles.
@@ 12
As Prayer II, except the bonus is +15 and may be spreadover 1-3 targets. One
target would get +15, three would get +5, etc.
@@ 13
As Earthwall, except the wall is made of stone and has a size up to 100’ cubic
feet. It can be chipped through.
@@ 14
Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. This shield subtracts 10
from all frontal spell attack rolls from one realm chosen at the casting of
this spell. If the caster performs no other actions during a round (i.e. a
100% action), he can ''parry'' (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The
parry bonus is equal to the sum of all the bonuses that the caster would
normally have for his spell’s base attack roll.
@@ 15
As Bladeturn I, except it affects 2 attacks.
@@ 16
As Aura, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 17
As Prayer I, except the bonus is +20 and may be spread over 1-4 targets.
@@ 18
As Deflections I, except it will deflect up to three missiles.
@@ 19
As Bladeturn I, except it affects up to three attacks.
@@ 20
As Spell Shield I, except it is effective against two realms of the caster’s
choice.
@@ 25
As any one of the lower level Wall spells on this list, except the wall can be
curved up to a semi circle.
@@ 30
As Deflections I, except it will deflect one missile per level of the caster.
@@ 50
Caster may cast any one of the spells of 20th level or lower on this list per
round. Any spells with a range of ''self'' may now use a range of ''touch''.
